messages.subject: [Action] DMS maintenance window — Saturday 24 Jan 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system will be unavailable on Saturday 24 January between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please save and close all open documents before 19:45. Email will not be affected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
